body:
Continued the SIP Phone NORTHSTAR's phased plan (Phase 2/SDP shipped earlier this session). Phase 3: a pure, functional call-state machine (Idle/Calling/Proceeding/Ringing/Established/Terminated + the send/recv event vocabulary for both directions), one entry point transition(state, event, dest) returning the next state or a real InvalidTransition error. Directly serves this ticket plus its siblings CAREPYRE-245435/CAREPYRE-535454/CAREPYRE-5435439434 (all describing the same finish line). 14/14 new assertions, 345/345 full suite, zero regressions. Remaining: Phase 4 (G.711 codec + real RTP send/receive loop) and embedding the native core into the actual Android APK (gap #2, the SDL2/NDK cross-compile blocker) -- real, separate, substantial work, left for next iteration. Session: sess-20260905-0712-8908a299

⚓ ☃
